T: Never feed them after midnight. You're fine before.
D: A boy gets a strange little creature for Christmas and breaks every one of the rules.
P: Serve the snacks well before midnight.
S: the chicken they trick Billy into feeding them after midnight
Drumsticks brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged twice in flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and white pepper, fried at 165C until 75C at the bone. Serve before 12.
Christmas in a snowy small town

Butter, brown sugar and golden syrup melted, flour, ginger, cinnamon and bicarb mixed in, chilled an hour, rolled, cut into little houses, baked at 180C for 10 minutes and piped with white royal icing.
Mrs Peltzer fights back with the kitchen appliances
Frozen berries, banana, Greek yoghurt and a spoon of honey blitzed in the blender until thick and smooth, poured into shot glasses and served straight away.
M: the bar the gremlins take over
Lamb mince simmered with carrot and gravy under a thick buttery mash, baked until golden on top.
Pork loin rind scored and salted, dried uncovered in the fridge overnight, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C until 63C inside, with apple sauce, roast potatoes and buttered beans.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with a dome of fluffy marshmallow frosting made from egg whites and hot sugar syrup, rolled in desiccated coconut.
K: rule two, keep water away from the mogwai
Sparkling water poured over ice with slices of lemon and lime, served well away from anything furry.

s.note: the chicken they trick Billy into feeding them after midnight
s.how: Brine 1kg chicken drumsticks overnight in 400ml buttermilk and 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 250g flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and white pepper. Fry at 165C until 75C at the bone. Serve well before 12.

s.note: Christmas in a snowy small town
s.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and half a tsp bicarb. Chill an hour, roll and cut into little houses. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and pipe with 200g icing sugar.

m.note: the bar the gremlins take over
m.how: Brown 800g lamb mince with 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 250ml beef stock and simmer for 20 minutes. Top with mash made from 1kg potatoes, 50g butter and 100ml milk, then bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.how: Bake 12 cupcakes from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour at 175C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites, then pour in 150g sugar boiled with 50ml water to 118C and beat until thick. Dome on top and roll in 100g coconut.

d.note: rule two, keep water away from the mogwai
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice and slices of lemon and lime. Pour over chilled sparkling water. Keep the jug well away from anything furry and don't spill a drop.
